cohort: 32,023 women with live singleton deliveries from the PeriBank database (22,484 vaginal deliveries and 9539 cesarean deliveries)
finding: While there was no difference in postpartum hemorrhage rates by blood type for vaginal deliveries, women with type O blood had a significantly higher rate of postpartum hemorrhage after cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: In the cesarean delivery group, there was a significantly higher rate of postpartum hemorrhage in women with type O blood compared to other blood types.
